verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own SQL reference documents native window functions (running totals, moving averages, rankings) and first-class VARIANT/OBJECT/ARRAY types for querying JSON and arrays, all built in rather than added as extensions. A community note says there is no generate_series equivalent, a minor gap in the analytical surface rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: evidence of CTE support, evidence of rich date/time types, independent hands-on corroboration of the window-function and semi-structured capabilities.
